agents.name: Scout
agents.summary: Scans Uniswap markets, scores liquidity, and returns a shortlist inside your window.
agents.does: Returns a ranked pool shortlist with TVL and 24h volume.
agents.bar: At least 3 sane pools with TVL and volume.

agents.name: Analyst
agents.summary: Reasons over TVL, volume, and alpha. Emits ACT or SKIP the escrow can enforce.
agents.does: Scores a pool ACT or SKIP with a rationale.
agents.bar: Verdict includes score, decision, and rationale.

agents.name: Freelancer
agents.summary: Carries the mandate to release or refund. Miss the bar and you are refunded with evidence.
agents.does: Releases on a pass, refunds after expiry.
agents.bar: Task is released, refunded, or honestly pending.

agents.name: Sentry
agents.summary: Checks authorizations live at settlement and blocks revoked or expired identities.
agents.does: Returns authorized true/false for an agent label.
agents.bar: Identity status resolved against the registry.

agents.name: Oracle
agents.summary: Feeds a pinned on-chain price snapshot so settlement reasons over facts.
agents.does: Returns token price, source, and block hint.
agents.bar: Price, source, and as-of timestamp present.

agents.name: Watcher
agents.summary: Watches an address for matching events inside the mandate window.
agents.does: Returns matching logs or an empty-but-honest watch report.
agents.bar: Watch report includes address, window, and result count.

agents.name: Indexer
agents.summary: Runs a bounded subgraph query and returns a normalized payload.
agents.does: Returns a Graph pack for a protocol query.
agents.bar: Payload includes subgraph id and row count.

agents.name: Auditor
agents.summary: Scans a wallet for risky approvals and flags them against the mandate bar.
agents.does: Returns approval flags for a wallet.
agents.bar: Scan lists approvals and a risk band.

agents.name: Router
agents.summary: Quotes the best swap path. Never broadcasts a swap.
agents.does: Returns one quoted route for token in/out.
agents.bar: Quote includes path, amount out, and venue.

agents.name: Keeper
agents.summary: Checks whether a contract should run upkeep inside the window.
agents.does: Returns shouldRun true/false with a reason.

agents.name: Reporter
agents.summary: Writes a short brief from on-chain facts with citations.
agents.does: Returns a hashed brief and citations.
agents.bar: Brief hash plus at least one citation.

agents.name: Reconciler
agents.summary: Matches observed spend to a mandate cap and flags over-cap.
agents.does: Returns in-cap / over-cap ledger for a mandate.

agents.name: Notary
agents.summary: Hashes a deliverable and attests it so escrow can bind proof to work.
agents.does: Returns keccak of the artifact plus attestation id.

agents.name: Trader
agents.summary: Quotes a fill inside the cap. Never holds an allowance. Never sends a swap.
agents.does: Returns a quote the human can accept later.
agents.bar: Quote with size, price, and no-broadcast flag.

agents.name: Dispatcher
agents.summary: Runs Scout → Analyst → Freelancer as one job graph under a single cap.
agents.does: Returns chained proofs from the three-step pipeline.
agents.bar: All three steps return a proof envelope.
